description:
Live-confirmed rough edges in error and help text that misdirect agents.

## Background

ActionableError messages print a doubled "Error: Error:" prefix; "Issue is already assigned" names neither the holder nor that same-assignee re-claim succeeds; the assignment commands (issue claim/release/unassign) and the lease commands (claim acquire/release) share verbs without cross-referencing each other in help; the claims-require-git failure suggests "git init" even when the actual condition is a git repository with no commits yet.

## Success Criteria

- [ ] [hard] REQ-01: Error output carries exactly one "Error:" prefix on every error path.
- [ ] [hard] REQ-02: The already-assigned error names the current assignee and states that re-claim by the same assignee succeeds.
- [ ] [hard] REQ-03: Assignment-command help and lease-command help each carry a one-line cross-reference distinguishing assignment from lease.
- [ ] [hard] REQ-04: The claims-require-git failure distinguishes a missing git repository from a repository with no commits and hints accordingly.
title: Error message polish: prefixes, assignee context, claim cross-references
